name: What is the difference between laminate and luxury vinyl plank (LVP) flooring?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between laminate and luxury vinyl plank (LVP) flooring?

acceptedAnswer.text: Laminate and luxury vinyl plank (LVP) are popular choices, but they differ in composition and water resistance. Laminate flooring is made primarily from wood byproducts with a photographic layer and a clear protective wear layer, making it susceptible to water damage if moisture penetrates the core. LVP, conversely, is 100% synthetic, composed of PVC, making it highly water-resistant or waterproof throughout. LVP tends to be more flexible, while laminate often feels harder underfoot. Both offer diverse aesthetics, but LVP is generally preferred for moisture-prone areas like bathrooms and kitchens.
acceptedAnswer.description: Laminate is wood-based and less water-resistant, while LVP is synthetic and often waterproof. LVP is better for wet areas, laminate is typically harder.
